instruction: Android OsmAnd has three site favorites for today: `North gate`, `Pump shed`, and `Service yard`. Record a 2-5 second Audio Recorder memo for each one, then use Android Files to export them to `Recordings` as `north_gate_memo.m4a`, `pump_shed_memo.m4a`, and `service_yard_memo.m4a`. Then create `/tmp/sites/packet.odt` in Linux LibreOffice Writer with one line per site relating its name, coordinates, and memo filename, and export `/tmp/sites/packet.pdf` as the field record.
